messages:
arjun: Quick RFC follow-up — modular tenancy demux plan.

arjun: TL;DR: extract tenant-routing + sidecar demux into a dedicated tenant-router service to reduce hot shared-state and make per-tenant batching/config easier. Goal: lower cognitive coupling and pay down shared-state debt.

arjun: Proposed phased playbook:
1) Add a thin tenant-router sidecar (proxy shim) behind feature flag.
2) Route a small percent of traffic (canary) + KV-prefix cache warmup.
3) Enable metrics + error budget gating (tracing spans, per-tenant lat p50/p95).
4) Gradual ramp + rollout policy with automatic fallback to legacy when errors exceed threshold.

arjun: Minimal config example:
```
service: inference
router:
  mode: sidecar
  feature_flag: tenant_router_v1
  canary_pct: 5
```

sara: Love the direction. Quick Q — how do we migrate per-tenant quotas & billing without double-counting during the canary?

michael: Plan: keep billing in control plane until cutover. Router emits a routing_token but the billing call remains to existing metering until explicit cutover window.

kevin: Observability note — add span annotation `tenant_router.v1` and set sampling to 100% for canary tenants, otherwise 10% global.

lia: Perf caveat — router will add 1-3ms p50 for local lookups. We need a fast in-memory LRU for tenant config; I'll prototype with 8k entries and measure.

deploy-bot: canary deployment started: staging -> tenant_router_v1 @ 1772468010 :rocket:

arjun: Assignments: michael -> rollout owner; lia -> perf validation; sara -> billing/metering migration docs; kevin -> tracing/alert rules.

kevin: Healthcheck snippet for the router endpoint:
```
curl -fsS http://localhost:8080/healthz || exit 1
# expect: {"ok":true, "cached":<int>}
```

michael: I'll coordinate the canary window. Targeting 1-week gradual ramp starting next Tue. If error budget > 2% in 30m window -> immediate rollback.

sara: I'll prepare a short migration checklist for finance & CS teams, include explicit rollback steps and sample telemetry queries.

opsbot: Note: remember to update incident runbook "tenant-router-cutover" and attach SLO changes before canary goes to prod.

kevin: I'll add a tracing dashboard and a synthetic that hits tenant-specific routes.

lia: I'll bench LRU prototype today and post numbers. If >5% CPU regression at p95 we throttle canary.

arjun: thanks all. small ask — keep replies in-thread, add PR links when ready. :thumbsup:

michael: ack.

sara: ack.

kevin: ack.

lia: ack.

deploy-bot: canary status: healthy at 5% after 22m; no regressions in p95 (staging metrics).

arjun: cool — schedule a 30m sync next week to confirm cutover window. Thanks.
